case.description: Elderly patient (65+) speaks slowly, repeats, forgets details, with a relative in background, wants an appointment
turns: Namaste doctor, main 65 saal ka hoon, um... thoda... sar dard hai, main aapke clinic mein ek appointment lena chahta hoon, shaam ka time... kya mil sakta hai?
(relative) Bhai, uska phone number yaad nahi aa raha, thoda der se bata denge?
